description: Creates a new event in Google Calendar. Supports both timed events (using start_datetime/end_datetime) and all-day events (using start_date/end_date). Can include title, description, location, and attendees. Returns the created event details including the event ID and link.

attachments.description: File attachments for the event. Maximum 25 attachments. Each attachment requires a file_url. For Google Drive files, use the Drive file URL format.

file_url.description: URL link to the attachment. Required.

calendar_id.description: Calendar ID to create the event in. Defaults to "primary".

end_date.description: End date for all-day events (e.g., "2024-01-02"). Use this for all-day events.

end_datetime.description: End date-time in RFC3339 format (e.g., "2024-01-01T11:00:00-05:00"). Use this for timed events.

end_timezone.description: Time zone for end time (e.g., "America/New_York"). Optional.

start_date.description: Start date for all-day events (e.g., "2024-01-01"). Use this for all-day events.

start_datetime.description: Start date-time in RFC3339 format (e.g., "2024-01-01T10:00:00-05:00"). Use this for timed events.

start_timezone.description: Time zone for start time (e.g., "America/New_York"). Optional.

name: create_calendar_event
